assumptions.description: Exactly375 per specified age-sex cell; uniform integer age within each cell. This is an equal-cell analytical design, not national representativeness.
Transfer selected US/Finnish/Iranian associations to the task Mexican selected population without target identification; Hoorn/Taiwan only context.
HbA1c assay differences and fasting plasma/serum glucose are not proven equivalent; target serum scale is assumed suitable for approximate relationship transfer.
Source diabetes/medication/HbA1c/fasting/age/complete-case restrictions differ from task; their relation is not identified and is assumed ignorable for chosen coefficients.
Source survey weighting/cluster sampling is not reproduced; constant-coefficient structure is assumed stable under equal-age-sex-cell analysis. No source-weighted feedback operator is claimed.

Binary Finnish age and fasting-duration adjustment differ from target continuous age and absent fasting duration. Transport of those coefficients is assumed; Hoorn additional adjustment is not silently removed.

Finnish supplement S1/S2 response units are NOT printed. Main Table1 glucose5-ish mmol/L/HbA1c5-ish percent and S1/S2 intercepts4.2966/5.1281 motivate inferred mmol/L and percentage-point response units. Preserve unlabelled originals; conversion18.0mg/dL per mmol/L is an explicit assumed scale mapping.

Target terms use age10,bmi5,glucose10; raw yearly/BMI-unit coefficients convert by10 or5. These are percentage-point changes, not relative percentages. No per-unit source operator is relabelled as per-ten.
Kerman r*SD(H)/SD(G) is a marginal slope, adopted as the conditional glucose coefficient by assumption. No reported adjusted coefficient or matched target correlation is claimed.

Finnish reduced BMI/sex coefficients and glucose kernel plus assumed conditional glucose coefficient are combined by algebra into direct terms. This identifies a hypothetical law, not a causal direct effect or recovered target relation.
Bounded-beta BMI support12-65, mean28.01, SD5, independent of age/sex; shape derived from moments. Bounds/dispersion/independence are assumptions; Pani mean is only a location anchor.
Glucose kernel location94, age slope.18/year, SD10 and truncation0<G<126 are chosen. Resample only G at fixed A/F/B; truncation shifts final source-like projections.
HbA1c intercept5.45 at declared centers is an author-chosen location near source middle-age means, not a fitted target statistic.
Independent centered Gamma(shape9) HbA1c residual with conditional SD.35. All integer moments finite; no residual SD is inferred from source marginal SD or SE; upper HbA1c tail remains unbounded.
No age-sex/BMI interactions, latent postload glycemia, medication/anemia mixture or measurement-error structure is identified; omission is an unassessed assumption.
Unknown source analysis missingness, weights and unsupported estimators remain not_computable, without substitution by an assumed unweighted complete-case calculation.
Rejection guard1000 rounds is an implementation failure guard, never a clipping rule; no sampling at import or local author execution.

design.derivation: Task-mandated cell design and author uniform within-cell integer age; output schema/IDs are mechanical.

bmi.derivation: Mean28.01 is a location anchor. Other moments/support are assumptions. c=(mean-low)*(high-mean)/sd^2-1; alpha=c*(mean-low)/(high-low); beta=c-alpha.

glucose.derivation: S1 unlabelled .0240*18=.432; men-minus-women .2472*18 reversed=-4.4496 after A_FIN_UNIT inference. Remaining location, age slope, SD, bounds and centers are declared choices; truncation changes actual projections.

hba1c.derivation: Age=.010/year from Pani NHANES. gamma=.23*.73/12.4=.013540322580645161 is marginal scale assumed conditional. BMI=.0125-gamma*.432=.006650580645161291; female=.023-gamma*(-4.4496)=.08324901935483871. Finnish scales inferred via A_FIN_UNIT. Residual scale=.35/sqrt(9), mean=9*scale. H intercept5.45 assumed; no target calibration.

implementation.derivation: Fail after1000 rejection rounds; never conditionally repair or clip an invalid output.
